newsitem.title: USA: Employee Solutions cites competition impact.
newsitem.headline: Employee Solutions cites competition impact.

text.p: Employee Solutions Inc said Monday increased competition and an overall weakness in workers' compensation and benefits markets had an impact on its earnings for the fourth quarter ending December 31.
The company said results for the quarter were also affected by its workers' compensation reserves, which were increased to $5.2 million at December 31.
Employee Solutions provides employers across the U.S. with employee payroll, human resources and benefits outsourcing services.
